title: Signature JSON parsing — Structured Document Parser
description: Signature original — JSON parsers build nested dicts/lists from braces and brackets. Strict parsers reject trailing commas and comments. JSON is the interchange default. This record documents a Signature-authored original method of the JAH archive toolkit, clearly labeled as Signature work rather than a public record.
demo:
# Structured parsing: parse JSON and XML samples into a uniform record list.
import json, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
def parse_json(s):
    data = json.loads(s)
    return data if isinstance(data, list) else [data]
def parse_xml(s):
    root = ET.fromstring(s)
    return [{c.tag: c.text for c in item} | {"_tag": item.tag} for item in root]
fmt, payload = "json", """[{"id": 1, "t": "a"}, {"id": 2, "t": "b"}]""".replace("\\n", "\n")
recs = parse_json(payload) if fmt == "json" else parse_xml(payload)
print(f"parsed {len(recs)} record(s) as {fmt}:")
for r in recs: print(" ", r)
provenance: Signature-authored original method created for the JAH archive toolkit; clearly labeled Signature, not a public record.
